messages:
alex: quick sync — planning a slow enable for `zenith-v2` tonight at 02:00 UTC. regional canary in ap-south first (5%), then ap-south+eu-west (25%), then global 50% with 2h hold before full cutover. reasons: low customer impact in ap-south and different network path. looking for SRE + QA + product ack.

karen: ok on timing. couple questions: fallback ordering? pin policy for customers on older contracts?

alex: fallback plan proposal: `[zenith-v2-4bit, zenith-v2, zenith-v1.9-degraded]`. pin policy: enterprise customers + gov-namespace remain pinned to v1.9 by default; early-access customers opt-in via `catalog.feature_flags: zenith_v2_early`. we'll add a migration window in the changelog.

miguel: telemetry & alerts I'll enable before canary: 
- sample full responses for 1% of requests (for hallucination detector)
- token-delta metric enabled
- alerts: error_rate >0.6% for 3m, gen_95p_latency >40% increase vs baseline for 10m, truncated_response_rate >0.5% for 5m
- memory-growth >5% sustained for 15m -> auto-drain
also recommend storing first 500 responses for offline diff.

alex: want to add a synthetic priming step: run top-50 customer prefixes for 20m to warm KV cache and avoid first-request penalty. config name: `priming/top50-20m`.

karen: SDK note: `response.meta.formatVersion` will bump from 2->3 on zenith-v2. need a short migration snippet. I'll paste the snippet into marketing doc.

product-lead: from product POV: we should not flip defaults for enterprise until GA + 90 days. add an early-access blurb in release notes. low-risk messaging only.

deploybot: running preflight checks now...

```
deploybot: preflight: model artifact checksum OK (sha256: b4d2...c9)
deploybot: infra: GPU pool health OK (available: 12/16)
deploybot: capacity reservation: ap-south 6/6 reserved for canary
deploybot: canary smoke tests: PASS (95p latency=102ms, errors=0.18%)
deploybot: observability hooks attached (span tags + sample-store)
```

miguel: I'll attach the regression-suite run and validation notebook to the post. QA results for 200 test prompts look nominal; slight reformatting in fenced code blocks — we plan to auto-normalize code fences via a prompt fallback when `language` detected.

sre-oncall: runbook reminders: automated rollback if alerts fire; manual rollback requires two approvers from ENG-RELEASES + SRE. if auto-rollback triggers, steps are: 1) set catalog pin to zenith-v1.9 2) drain zenith-v2 instances 3) notify pinned customers 4) escalate if >30m unresolved. please include runbook link in deploy message.

alex: runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/model-rollouts#zenith-v2 (will be in deploy commit).

karen: small ask — can we limit routed requests to <= 4096 tokens on canary? long-context latencies degrade.

alex: yes. will add route guard `x-max-seq=4096` and `cache.prefill=true` for canary.

product-lead: add changelog line: "Note: minor formatting differences in code fences; set `response.meta.formatVersion=3` to opt in."

deploybot: scheduling deploy: 
- 02:00 UTC: ap-south canary (5%)
- 02:20 UTC: expand to ap-south+eu-west (25%)
- 02:50 UTC: expand to global 50% and hold 2h
deploybot: rollout config written to `catalog/zenith-v2/rollouts/3432106789.yaml`

alex: last check — all green from QA + SRE?

miguel: QA green, regression diffs attached.

sre-oncall: SRE acked. monitoring dashboards pre-created.

karen: +1 from docs/SDK. snippet posted to marketing draft.

deploybot: executing: ap-south canary (5%)...

```
deploybot: step 1: apply route changes -> OK
deploybot: step 2: allocate pool -> OK
deploybot: step 3: smoke tests -> OK
```

alex: initial telemetry after 10m: gen_95p=110ms (baseline 100ms), error_rate=0.22% (baseline 0.18%), truncated_rate=0.09%. within tolerances. continuing to priming window for another 10m before expand.

miguel: sampling looks good; uploading first batch of full responses for offline QA.

sre-oncall: note: if memory-growth alert fires, auto-drain will remove zenith-v2 from routing and set pin to v1.9 automatically. we will not silently rollback without incident channel creation.

product-lead: tagging comms team to prepare a brief: non-breaking changes, opt-in for enterprise.

alex: expanding to 25% now. hold_until tag set to 3432117600 (2h hold at 50% later).

deploybot: expansion to 25% -> OK.

alex: monitoring: 95p=112ms, error_rate=0.3%. still within thresholds. proceeding to warm hold plan.

karen: merging SDK snippet into release notes now.

miguel: one sticky item: a tiny uptick in code-format diffs for backtick fences. QA will monitor and can trigger prompt-fallback if needed.

sre-oncall: reminder to include the incident template in the deploy message so we can open one quickly if thresholds cross.

alex: noted — will include incident stub and contact list. launching warm hold. will update channel for the 50% decision.

product-lead: thanks team. Ill wait for the 50% checkin before announcing GA window.
